notes: No leftovers of an earlier attempt were found. Batch-local helper file g08_offline.py (no Module class) holds the shared untrusted-data, timestamp, SQLite-index and refresh-job HTTP-scope helpers. Final conditions over metadata: P190 cond 2 splits the proposal, so poc_index is disclosure third_party (derived shares_input True, max TLP AMBER+STRICT) while exploit_index is disclosure none (hosts () - its datasets are fetched by the dataset manager from gitlab.com/raw.githubusercontent.com). Provider ownership: raw.githubusercontent.com/github.com -> extension github__p2-G08-2.json (sources exploit_index_metasploit, exploit_index_nuclei, poc_index_nomi, poc_index_trickest, cve_offline_mirror_cvelist; host release-assets.githubusercontent.com, mapped to null in owners.json, added to the GitHub provider because its operator is GitHub); gitlab.com -> the seeded source gitlab.exploitdb_csv (no extension needed); api.msrc.microsoft.com -> new provider msrc.json (tier trusted). The real Exploit-DB rows (GPL-2.0) are not vendored: tests use the synthetic edb_synthetic.csv. cve_offline_mirror plugs into cve_record through the existing register_cve_mirror hook (cve_record reads it first, verified by a test) and stores records minimised (no credits). poc_index: a 429 with Retry-After backs off raw.githubusercontent.com for both indexes (RATE_LIMITED, could not verify); per-source failures otherwise go to source_statuses. Offline modules report UNAVAILABLE 'dataset' until their datasets/index exist. Licence evidence: PoC-in-GitHub LICENSE is CC0-1.0 and trickest/cve MIT (fetched 2026-11-26), quoted in the provider extension. MSRC ignores If-Modified-Since (verified by the prep), so refreshes are driven by CurrentReleaseDate with cadence caps (7 days, 24 h for the two newest months). Not delivered (backlog docs/backlog/p2-G08-2.md): the CLI sync commands, streamed downloads/release-asset discovery, severity-like-KEV wiring in CR15 and the card, doctor wiring. Full offline suite: the remaining failures are in other batches' work in progress (ioc_extract, ransomfeed, typosquat, entity_types platform fragment, rule fixtures, G08-1 modules circl_vulnlookup/osv_ghsa/vulncheck, stale notices of unfinished batches, xposedornot lint); none involve this batch's files.
